title: The sign test: 8 positive differences out of 10
caption: Under H₀ each difference is positive with probability 1/2, so the count is B(10, 0.5). P(X ≥ 8) = 0.0547 > 0.05: not significant.
alt: Bar chart of B(10, 0.5) with the bars for 8, 9 and 10 shaded, total 0.0547.
description: Under H₀ the number of positive differences is B(10, 0.5).
The one-sided p-value is the shaded area, 0.0547.
It exceeds 0.05, so do not reject.
